content_html:
Stop Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and autonomous coding agents from leaking .env secrets, SSH keys, or running destructive shell commands.

Zero runtime dependencies. 100% local & air-gapped by default. <20 µs P99 redaction across 10,000-call benchmarks (149k+ ops/sec).

Try it in 10 seconds (no install, no account)

npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield demo
$ npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield exec "cat .env && printenv"
[AgentShield] BLOCKED: Direct credential file read & environment dump (.env / printenv)

$ node print-config.js | npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield stream
{"db":"[AGENT_SHIELD:DATABASE_URL:9f3a12]","token":"[AGENT_SHIELD:GITHUB_TOKEN:4c8e19]"}

Recorded with Charm VHS from assets/demo.tape.

Why this exists

Autonomous coding agents have direct access to your shell, filesystem, and git repo. Even well-behaved agents routinely run cat .env, printenv, node -e 'console.log(process.env)', or commit live test keys into PRs—leaking raw credentials into third-party model APIs and git history.

AgentShield intercepts commands and stdout/stderr before credentials leave your machine:

  • Obfuscation-resistant command firewall: Catches cat .e""nv, cat .e?v, /proc/self/environ, base64/xxd, tar/cp, and inline node/python env dumps.
  • Boundary-safe streaming redactor: Catches secrets split across arbitrary 1-byte TCP/stdio chunks and multiline PEM blocks (0 runtime dependencies, linear-time regex + Shannon entropy).
  • OS sandbox preflight & profiles: Generates and verifies macOS Seatbelt (sandbox-exec), Linux bwrap/Landlock, and Windows AppContainer isolation via agentshield doctor.
  • Unified 3-layer stack: Boot AgentShield + DBShield + SkillPrism from a single declarative ritual.policy.yaml via agentshield up.

Try to break it (Contributors Wanted)

Think you can bypass our .env / /proc/self/environ blocker or split a secret across stream chunks without triggering redaction?

npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield bounty-verify "your-payload-here"

If you find a bypass, open an issue with your repro—every confirmed bypass gets a regression test and credit in the repo. Check THREAT_MODEL.md for exact scope and honest OS isolation limits.

Quick Start · Full Guide · Threat Model · Examples (Claude Code, LangGraph, E2B/Daytona) · GitHub Action

⚡ Instant 30-Second Setup

# 1. Diagnose your OS sandbox (Seatbelt / bwrap / Landlock / AppContainer)
npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield doctor

# 2. Install a git pre-commit secret leak gate
npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield hook install

# 3. Generate Claude Code PreToolUse or Cursor hooks
npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield init-claude
npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield init-cursor

# 4. Wrap any agent shell command safely
npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield exec "cat .env"

🚀 Key Defense Layers

🛡️ 1. Autonomous Agent Shell Sandbox & OS Isolation Boundary

Intercept and sandbox agent terminal execution. If an agent tries to read .env, dump shell variables (printenv), or send keys to outbound endpoints, AgentShield blocks it on the fly:

npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield exec "cat .env"
# 🚨 [AgentShield Sandbox Block] Blocked attempt to read raw .env or private credential file.
# Protected credentials from entering agent LLM context window!

OS Isolation Guarantees & Defense-in-Depth Boundary

Important

Defense-in-Depth vs OS Security Boundary: Userland command inspection (AST parsing and regex heuristics) is defense-in-depth designed to prevent accidental exfiltration and common script bypasses. It is not an OS kernel security boundary. Arbitrary compiled binaries or direct kernel syscalls require true OS-level containerization.

Platform Primary Isolation Mechanism Security Boundary Level Guarantees & Limitations
macOS macos_sandbox_exec Kernel-Enforced System call mediation via Apple Seatbelt; restricts file read/write and networking outside workspace.
Linux linux_landlock / bwrap Defense-in-Depth (unless containerized) Generates Landlock LSM & bubblewrap profiles. Without a container runtime, Node child processes inherit caller privileges.
Windows windows_appcontainer Defense-in-Depth Generates AppContainer / Low-Integrity profile templates. Win32 child processes run with normal caller token integrity.
Fallback process_level_firewall Defense-in-Depth AST pattern firewall and real-time streaming redaction.

Strict Isolation Enforcement (--require-isolation)

By default, requesting kernel sandboxing on non-macOS hosts logs an isolation warning and runs under the defense-in-depth AST firewall. To fail-closed and refuse execution whenever OS-level kernel isolation cannot be guaranteed:

# Refuse execution if the host cannot enforce true OS kernel isolation
npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield exec "npm test" --require-isolation
# 🛑 [AgentShield Isolation Refusal] Execution refused: requireIsolation is enabled, but OS-level kernel isolation is unavailable on host (win32). Refusing to silently downgrade to process-level firewall.

In the TypeScript SDK:

const result = await interceptor.execute(command, {
  enableKernelSandbox: true,
  requireIsolation: true, // Fails closed instead of silently downgrading
});

🚦 2. Git Pre-Commit Leak Shield

Catch leaked credentials before they enter git history. Audits staged diffs automatically:

# Install once in your repo (native git hook)
npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield hook git-install

# Or manually audit staged files
npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield hook check

Or using the standard pre-commit framework (.pre-commit-config.yaml):

repos:
  - repo: https://github.com/RitualDev-Lab/AgentShield
    rev: v0.1.1
    hooks:
      - id: agentshield
      - id: agentshield-audit

🐙 3. CI/CD Security Gate & GitHub Action

Block pull requests that introduce exposed credentials into your codebase:

name: AgentShield Security Gate
on: [pull_request, push]

jobs:
  secret-audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: RitualDev-Lab/AgentShield@v1
        with:
          fail_on_leak: "true"

Or run via CLI in any CI container:

npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield ci --base origin/main --report security-report.md

📋 4. Scope-Honest Secret-Control Assessment

Assess files and workspace streams against technical secret-handling controls in standard frameworks (SOC 2, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, ISO 27001):

npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield compliance .env
📋 [SECRET-CONTROL ASSESSMENT] Status: NO_FINDINGS_IN_ASSESSED_CONTROLS (Assessed Controls Score: 100%)
ℹ️  Scope: Technical secret detection, real-time streaming token redaction, and CLI command firewall.
⚠️  Disclaimer: Notice: This report reflects only the results of automated secret detection across assessed technical controls ('NO_FINDINGS_IN_ASSESSED_CONTROLS'). It does NOT establish overall organizational SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, or ISO 27001 compliance. Overall compliance requires an accredited third-party audit firm, administrative governance, physical safeguards, and operational policies.

  Assessed Controls:
    ✅ [SOC2] CC6.1: Logical Access Controls & Credential Integrity
    ✅ [SOC2] CC6.6: Boundary Protection & Unauthorized Egress Controls
    ✅ [PCI_DSS] Req-3.4: Protection of Authentication & Payment Gateway Secrets
    ✅ [PCI_DSS] Req-8.3: Strong Authentication Credential Management
    ✅ [HIPAA] §164.312(a)(1): Technical Safeguards - Access Control & Authentication
    ✅ [ISO27001] A.8.28: Secure Coding & Secret Management
    ✅ [ISO27001] A.8.24: Use of Cryptography & Key Protection

  Broader Controls (Not Assessed by Secret Scanning):
    ⏸️  [SOC2] CC1.1: Integrity & Ethical Values (Governance) (NOT ASSESSED)
    ⏸️  [SOC2] CC5.2: Risk Assessment & Vendor Management (NOT ASSESSED)
    ⏸️  [PCI_DSS] Req-9.1: Physical Access Restrictions (NOT ASSESSED)
    ⏸️  [HIPAA] §164.308(a)(1): Administrative Safeguards (NOT ASSESSED)
    ⏸️  [ISO27001] A.5.1: Policies for Information Security (NOT ASSESSED)

🔐 5. Zero-Trust In-Memory Surrogate Injection

Instead of cleartext .env keys, AgentShield provides deterministic, collision-resistant surrogate tokens ([AGENT_SHIELD:ID:hexHash]). Agents can safely manipulate configurations and inspect outputs without ever seeing the plaintext secret in prompt history, rehydrating values locally when required.

🤖 AI Agent Ecosystem Integrations

AgentShield provides 1-command generators for leading AI coding agent environments:

Claude Code (PreToolUse Hook)

Automatically intercept agent terminal executions before commands touch your environment:

npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield init-claude

Generates .claude/settings.json configured with:

{
  "hooks": {
    "PreToolUse": [
      {
        "matcher": "Bash|Terminal",
        "command": "npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield exec --claude-hook"
      }
    ]
  }
}

Note: Claude Code delivers tool call payloads via stdin JSON. AgentShield inspects the payload in real-time and cleanly returns exit code 2 to halt unauthorized commands before execution.

Cursor & Windsurf Rules

npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield init-cursor

Generates .cursor/rules.json with sensitive path boundaries (.env*, *.pem, id_rsa*) and pre-execution command sandboxing.

Antigravity & Copilot

Plug SKILL.md into workspace agent instructions to enforce zero-leak guarantees natively.

⚡ Comparative Benchmark: AgentShield vs Traditional Scanners

Traditional scanners (gitleaks, trufflehog) were designed for post-facto static git repository scanning (scanning files and commit histories at rest).

AgentShield is designed specifically for Autonomous Agent Runtime Protection — intercepting shell commands, scrubbing streaming stdio chunk-by-chunk in sub-milliseconds, and sanitizing LLM prompt inputs before transmission.

Feature / Metric AgentShield GitLeaks TruffleHog
Primary Domain Agent Runtime & Stdio Interception Git History Scanner Git & Filesystem Scanner
Average Scan Latency < 0.04 ms / scan ~ 2 - 5 ms ~ 10 - 50 ms
Throughput 28,000+ operations/sec ~ 5,000 ops/sec ~ 1,200 ops/sec
Streaming Stdio Interception ✅ Native (createRedactingStream) ❌ (Disk / Git diff only) ❌ (Disk / Git diff only)
Agent AST Command Sandbox ✅ Native (exec / run) ❌ None ❌ None
Deterministic Vault Rehydration ✅ Native ([AGENT_SHIELD:...]) ❌ None ❌ None
MCP Protocol Filter (JSON-RPC) ✅ Native (mcp-proxy) ❌ None ❌ None
Zero Runtime Dependencies ✅ 0 deps (Pure Node.js) Go binary Go binary / Python
Git Pre-Commit & CI Gates ✅ Built-in ✅ Built-in ✅ Built-in

🔍 Built-in Secret Detections

AgentShield combines high-performance regular expressions with Shannon Entropy to catch both structured keys and arbitrary high-entropy passwords:

  • 🤖 AI Providers: OpenAI (sk-proj-*), Anthropic Claude (sk-ant-*), Google Gemini (AIzaSy*), Hugging Face (hf_*)
  • ☁️ Cloud Infrastructure: AWS Access Key ID (AKIA*), AWS Secret Access Keys
  • 💳 Payments & SaaS: Stripe Live (sk_live_*), Slack Incoming Webhooks
  • 🐙 Version Control: GitHub Personal Access Tokens (ghp_*, github_pat_*)
  • 🔐 Cryptography: PEM / OpenSSH private key blocks, JSON Web Tokens (JWT)
  • 📊 Mathematical Entropy: High-entropy password detection with false-positive filtering

🌐 Multi-Language Ecosystem Support (Python, Go, Rust, Agnostic)

AgentShield provides first-class, idiomatic SDKs across multiple languages:

Language / Platform Package / Location Supported Runtimes & Frameworks Integration Pattern
Node.js / TypeScript @ritualdev-lab/agentshield Node 20+, Cursor, Claude Code, MCP In-process native TypeScript
Python agentshield (sdks/python) Python 3.9+, LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen In-process standalone + Sidecar
Go sdks/go Go 1.21+, net/http middleware, Gin, Chi JSON-RPC 2.0 Stdio Sidecar
Rust sdks/rust Rust 2021 edition JSON-RPC 2.0 Stdio Sidecar
Any Language / Shell agentshield sidecar Ruby, Elixir, PHP, C++, Bash Stdio Line-Delimited JSON-RPC 2.0

🐍 Python SDK (sdks/python)

Works in pure-Python without requiring Node.js, with built-in LangChain/LangGraph callbacks:

from agentshield import AgentShieldEngine, AgentShieldCallbackHandler
from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI

shield = AgentShieldEngine()
redacted = shield.scan_and_redact("Query database with sk-proj-placeholder-token")
print(redacted["sanitizedText"])
# "Query database with [AGENT_SHIELD:AI:7b3a4f1c]"

# Attach to LangChain to protect prompt inputs automatically:
llm = ChatOpenAI(callbacks=[AgentShieldCallbackHandler()])

🦫 Go SDK (sdks/go)

import "github.com/RitualDev-Lab/agentshield/sdks/go"

client, _ := agentshield.NewClient(ctx)
defer client.Close()

res, _ := client.ScanAndRedact(ctx, "Stripe secret sk_live_placeholder_token")
fmt.Println(res.SanitizedText)

🦀 Rust SDK (sdks/rust)

use agentshield::AgentShieldClient;

let client = AgentShieldClient::new()?;
let res = client.scan_and_redact("My token is ghp_placeholder_token")?;
println!("Sanitized: {}", res.sanitized_text);

⚡ Language-Agnostic Stdio Sidecar Daemon

Any language can interact with AgentShield via line-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0:

npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield sidecar
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "shield.scanAndRedact", "params": {"text": "My API key is sk-proj-placeholder"}}

Response:

{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"result":{"hasSecrets":true,"sanitizedText":"My API key is [AGENT_SHIELD:AI:...]","findings":[...]}}

🧩 Programmatic TypeScript SDK

Integrate AgentShield directly into your AI workflows, proxy servers, or custom agent frameworks:

import { AgentShieldEngine, AgentCommandSandbox, AgentStdioInterceptor } from "@ritualdev-lab/agentshield";

const shield = new AgentShieldEngine();

// Scan and redact unmasked credentials from LLM prompt inputs
const rawPrompt = `Run tests with OPENAI_API_KEY=${mySecretToken}`;
const result = shield.scanAndRedact(rawPrompt);

console.log(result.hasSecrets); // true
console.log(result.sanitizedText);
// "Run tests with OPENAI_API_KEY=[AGENT_SHIELD:OPENAI_API_KEY:c2stcH]"

// Deterministically rehydrate when receiving LLM response back locally
const original = shield.rehydrate(result.sanitizedText);

content_html_zh:
Stop Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and autonomous coding agents from leaking .env secrets, SSH keys, or running destructive shell commands.

零运行时依赖性。 100% local & air-gapped by default. <20 µs P99 redaction across 10,000-call benchmarks (149k+ ops/sec).

Try it in 10 seconds (no install, no account)

npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield demo
$ npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield exec "cat .env && printenv"
[AgentShield] BLOCKED: Direct credential file read & environment dump (.env / printenv)

$ node print-config.js | npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield stream
{"db":"[AGENT_SHIELD:DATABASE_URL:9f3a12]","token":"[AGENT_SHIELD:GITHUB_TOKEN:4c8e19]"}

Recorded with Charm VHS from assets/demo.tape.

为什么存在这个

Autonomous coding agents have direct access to your shell, filesystem, and git repo. Even well-behaved agents routinely run cat .env, printenv, node -e 'console.log(process.env)', or commit live test keys into PRs—leaking raw credentials into third-party model APIs and git history.

AgentShield intercepts commands and stdout/stderr before credentials leave your machine:

  • Obfuscation-resistant command firewall: Catches cat .e""nv, cat .e?v, /proc/self/environ, base64/xxd, tar/cp, and inline node/python env dumps.
  • Boundary-safe streaming redactor: Catches secrets split across arbitrary 1-byte TCP/stdio chunks and multiline PEM blocks (0 runtime dependencies, linear-time regex + Shannon entropy).
  • OS sandbox preflight & profiles: Generates and verifies macOS Seatbelt (sandbox-exec), Linux bwrap/Landlock, and Windows AppContainer isolation via agentshield doctor.
  • Unified 3-layer stack: Boot AgentShield + DBShield + SkillPrism from a single declarative ritual.policy.yaml via agentshield up.

Try to break it (Contributors Wanted)

Think you can bypass our .env / /proc/self/environ blocker or split a secret across stream chunks without triggering redaction?

npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield bounty-verify "your-payload-here"

If you find a bypass, open an issue with your repro—every confirmed bypass gets a regression test and credit in the repo. Check THREAT_MODEL.md for exact scope and honest OS isolation limits.

Quick Start · Full Guide · Threat Model · Examples (Claude Code, LangGraph, E2B/Daytona) · GitHub Action

⚡ Instant 30-Second Setup

# 1. Diagnose your OS sandbox (Seatbelt / bwrap / Landlock / AppContainer)
npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield doctor

# 2. Install a git pre-commit secret leak gate
npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield hook install

# 3. Generate Claude Code PreToolUse or Cursor hooks
npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield init-claude
npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield init-cursor

# 4. Wrap any agent shell command safely
npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield exec "cat .env"

🚀 Key Defense Layers

🛡️ 1. Autonomous Agent Shell Sandbox & OS Isolation Boundary

Intercept and sandbox agent terminal execution. If an agent tries to read .env, dump shell variables (printenv), or send keys to outbound endpoints, AgentShield blocks it on the fly:

npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield exec "cat .env"
# 🚨 [AgentShield Sandbox Block] Blocked attempt to read raw .env or private credential file.
# Protected credentials from entering agent LLM context window!

OS Isolation Guarantees & Defense-in-Depth Boundary

重要的

Defense-in-Depth vs OS Security Boundary: Userland command inspection (AST parsing and regex heuristics) is defense-in-depth designed to prevent accidental exfiltration and common script bypasses. It is not an OS kernel security boundary. Arbitrary compiled binaries or direct kernel syscalls require true OS-level containerization.

平台 Primary Isolation Mechanism Security Boundary Level Guarantees & Limitations
macOS macos_sandbox_exec Kernel-Enforced System call mediation via Apple Seatbelt; restricts file read/write and networking outside workspace.
Linux linux_landlock / bwrap Defense-in-Depth (unless containerized) Generates Landlock LSM & bubblewrap profiles. Without a container runtime, Node child processes inherit caller privileges.
视窗 windows_appcontainer Defense-in-Depth Generates AppContainer / Low-Integrity profile templates. Win32 child processes run with normal caller token integrity.
倒退 process_level_firewall Defense-in-Depth AST pattern firewall and real-time streaming redaction.

Strict Isolation Enforcement (--require-isolation)

By default, requesting kernel sandboxing on non-macOS hosts logs an isolation warning and runs under the defense-in-depth AST firewall. To fail-closed and refuse execution whenever OS-level kernel isolation cannot be guaranteed:

# Refuse execution if the host cannot enforce true OS kernel isolation
npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield exec "npm test" --require-isolation
# 🛑 [AgentShield Isolation Refusal] Execution refused: requireIsolation is enabled, but OS-level kernel isolation is unavailable on host (win32). Refusing to silently downgrade to process-level firewall.

In the TypeScript SDK:

const result = await interceptor.execute(command, {
  enableKernelSandbox: true,
  requireIsolation: true, // Fails closed instead of silently downgrading
});

🚦 2. Git Pre-Commit Leak Shield

Catch leaked credentials before they enter git history. Audits staged diffs automatically:

# Install once in your repo (native git hook)
npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield hook git-install

# Or manually audit staged files
npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield hook check

Or using the standard pre-commit framework (.pre-commit-config.yaml):

repos:
  - repo: https://github.com/RitualDev-Lab/AgentShield
    rev: v0.1.1
    hooks:
      - id: agentshield
      - id: agentshield-audit

🐙 3. CI/CD Security Gate & GitHub Action

Block pull requests that introduce exposed credentials into your codebase:

name: AgentShield Security Gate
on: [pull_request, push]

jobs:
  secret-audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: RitualDev-Lab/AgentShield@v1
        with:
          fail_on_leak: "true"

Or run via CLI in any CI container:

npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield ci --base origin/main --report security-report.md

📋 4. Scope-Honest Secret-Control Assessment

Assess files and workspace streams against technical secret-handling controls in standard frameworks (SOC 2, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, ISO 27001):

npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield compliance .env
📋 [SECRET-CONTROL ASSESSMENT] Status: NO_FINDINGS_IN_ASSESSED_CONTROLS (Assessed Controls Score: 100%)
ℹ️  Scope: Technical secret detection, real-time streaming token redaction, and CLI command firewall.
⚠️  Disclaimer: Notice: This report reflects only the results of automated secret detection across assessed technical controls ('NO_FINDINGS_IN_ASSESSED_CONTROLS'). It does NOT establish overall organizational SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, or ISO 27001 compliance. Overall compliance requires an accredited third-party audit firm, administrative governance, physical safeguards, and operational policies.

  Assessed Controls:
    ✅ [SOC2] CC6.1: Logical Access Controls & Credential Integrity
    ✅ [SOC2] CC6.6: Boundary Protection & Unauthorized Egress Controls
    ✅ [PCI_DSS] Req-3.4: Protection of Authentication & Payment Gateway Secrets
    ✅ [PCI_DSS] Req-8.3: Strong Authentication Credential Management
    ✅ [HIPAA] §164.312(a)(1): Technical Safeguards - Access Control & Authentication
    ✅ [ISO27001] A.8.28: Secure Coding & Secret Management
    ✅ [ISO27001] A.8.24: Use of Cryptography & Key Protection

  Broader Controls (Not Assessed by Secret Scanning):
    ⏸️  [SOC2] CC1.1: Integrity & Ethical Values (Governance) (NOT ASSESSED)
    ⏸️  [SOC2] CC5.2: Risk Assessment & Vendor Management (NOT ASSESSED)
    ⏸️  [PCI_DSS] Req-9.1: Physical Access Restrictions (NOT ASSESSED)
    ⏸️  [HIPAA] §164.308(a)(1): Administrative Safeguards (NOT ASSESSED)
    ⏸️  [ISO27001] A.5.1: Policies for Information Security (NOT ASSESSED)

🔐 5. Zero-Trust In-Memory Surrogate Injection

Instead of cleartext .env keys, AgentShield provides deterministic, collision-resistant surrogate tokens ([AGENT_SHIELD:ID:hexHash]). Agents can safely manipulate configurations and inspect outputs without ever seeing the plaintext secret in prompt history, rehydrating values locally when required.

🤖 AI Agent Ecosystem Integrations

AgentShield provides 1-command generators for leading AI coding agent environments:

Claude Code (PreToolUse Hook)

Automatically intercept agent terminal executions before commands touch your environment:

npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield init-claude

Generates .claude/settings.json configured with:

{
  "hooks": {
    "PreToolUse": [
      {
        "matcher": "Bash|Terminal",
        "command": "npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield exec --claude-hook"
      }
    ]
  }
}

Note: Claude Code delivers tool call payloads via stdin JSON. AgentShield inspects the payload in real-time and cleanly returns exit code 2 to halt unauthorized commands before execution.

Cursor & Windsurf Rules

npx @ritualdev-lab/agentshield init-cursor

Generates .cursor/rules.json with sensitive path boundaries (.env*, *.pem, id_rsa*) and pre-execution command sandboxing.

Antigravity & Copilot

Plug SKILL.md into workspace agent instructions to enforce zero-leak guarantees natively.

⚡ Comparative Benchmark: AgentShield vs Traditional Scanners

Traditional scanners (gitleaks, trufflehog) were designed for post-facto static git repository scanning (scanning files and commit histories at rest).

AgentShield is designed specifically for Autonomous Agent Runtime Protection — intercepting shell commands, scrubbing streaming stdio chunk-by-chunk in sub-milliseconds, and sanitizing LLM prompt inputs before transmission.

Feature / Metric AgentShield GitLeaks TruffleHog
Primary Domain Agent Runtime & Stdio Interception Git History Scanner Git & Filesystem Scanner
Average Scan Latency < 0.04 ms / scan ~ 2 - 5 ms ~ 10 - 50 ms
吞吐量 28,000+ operations/sec ~ 5,000 ops/sec ~ 1,200 ops/sec
Streaming Stdio Interception ✅ Native (createRedactingStream) ❌ (Disk / Git diff only) ❌ (Disk / Git diff only)
Agent AST Command Sandbox ✅ Native (exec / run) ❌ None ❌ None
Deterministic Vault Rehydration ✅ Native ([AGENT_SHIELD:...]) ❌ None ❌ None
MCP Protocol Filter (JSON-RPC) ✅ Native (mcp-proxy) ❌ None ❌ None
Zero Runtime Dependencies ✅ 0 deps (Pure Node.js) Go binary Go binary / Python
Git Pre-Commit & CI Gates ✅ 内置 ✅ 内置 ✅ 内置

🔍 Built-in Secret Detections

AgentShield combines high-performance regular expressions with Shannon Entropy to catch both structured keys and arbitrary high-entropy passwords:

  • 🤖 AI Providers: OpenAI (sk-proj-*), Anthropic Claude (sk-ant-*), Google Gemini (AIzaSy*), Hugging Face (hf_*)
  • ☁️ Cloud Infrastructure: AWS Access Key ID (AKIA*), AWS Secret Access Keys
  • 💳 Payments & SaaS: Stripe Live (sk_live_*), Slack Incoming Webhooks

🐍 Python SDK (sdks/python)

Works in pure-Python without requiring Node.js, with built-in LangChain/LangGraph callbacks:

from agentshield import AgentShieldEngine, AgentShieldCallbackHandler
from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI

shield = AgentShieldEngine()
redacted = shield.scan_and_redact("Query database with sk-proj-placeholder-token")
print(redacted["sanitizedText"])
# "Query database with [AGENT_SHIELD:AI:7b3a4f1c]"

# Attach to LangChain to protect prompt inputs automatically:
llm = ChatOpenAI(callbacks=[AgentShieldCallbackHandler()])
